For the purposes of this Resolution, the following definitions are adopted: I - disposable absorbent products for external use: articles intended for body cleansing, applied directly to the skin, with the purpose of absorbing or retaining organic excretions and secretions, such as urine, feces, breast milk and those of a menstrual and intermenstrual nature; and II - disposable absorbent products for intravaginal use: articles intended to absorb or retain menstrual and intermenstrual excretions and secretions, applied by vaginal insertion. Sole paragraph. Female absorbents for external use, baby diapers, adult diapers, absorbents for incontinence and breast milk pads are included in the product group referred to in item I.
For the purposes of this Resolution, menstrual cup is defined as an intravaginal device used to collect menstrual flow.
